title: BOX OF EARLY 20TH CENTURY BOOK...
reason: Under-described: Aldine pocket libraries, a 1909 Nick Carter Weekly and an 1891-92 Drury Lane Humpty Dumpty souvenir with a Marie Lloyd portrait; collectable ephemera but tatty. Value band is my estimate only, no comparables checked.
findings: Five photos of a jumbled pile of roughly 18 to 20 old story papers, pocket libraries, magazines and one theatre souvenir, mostly 1890s to 1910s, so older than the 'early 20th century' in the title. Legible items: Aldine Publishing Co (London) No. 202 'The Lost Balloon' (Aldine Invention, Travel & Adventure Library, 'Jules Verne outdone'), No. 278 'Murella's P...' (Aldine Boys' First-Rate Pocket Library), No. 288 'Conrad the Sailor...' (Aldine 'O'er Land and Sea' Library), another Aldine title 'The Spook Steed of the Sto...', and a green 'Robin Hood ... Desperate Flight' booklet. American dime novels in a polybag: 'New Nick Carter Weekly' (Street & Smith) dated Jan 16 1909, 5 cents, number reads about 625 (digits not certain), and 'Frank Merriwell's Own, Tip Top Weekly'. Also 'New Buffalo Bill Library' No. 161 'The Haunted Ranch' (1d), 'Romance' No. 252 'My Lady May' (1d weekly), Cassell's 'New Penny Magazine' No. 4 (about 1913), 'Collins' Penny Library: Audrey Marsh', a Cadbury's Cocoa 'The Penny Library of Famous Books' booklet, an 'Answers' novel 'The Silvermedal...', 'Dick T...' (probably a Dick Turpin title), 'Tearl's Venture' and an orange booklet headed 'Snor...'. Best single piece is a Drury Lane Theatre pantomime souvenir: 'Humpty Dumpty or the Yellow Dwarf and the Fair One with the Golden Locks', Sir Augustus Harris, season 1891-92, written by Harry Nicholls and Sir Augustus Harris, One Shilling, cover photograph captioned Miss Marie Lloyd by Russell & Sons. Marie Lloyd and music hall memorabilia is collected, and Aldine pocket libraries and a 1909 Nick Carter are collectable boys' paper ephemera. Completeness of each item is not checkable from the photos.
condition: Poor to fair overall: covers chipped, torn and creased, edges tanned and foxed, several spines splitting. The Humpty Dumpty souvenir has a large tear across the lower right, a loose off-white leaf and brown staining. Aldine pocket libraries are rubbed with missing edge pieces ('The Lost Balloon' has a torn upper edge). Nick Carter and Tip Top copies are creased inside a polybag.
rescore_note: Real period ephemera (Aldine pocket libraries, a 1909 Nick Carter, an 1891-92 Drury Lane Humpty Dumpty souvenir with Marie Lloyd) but all poor to fair with torn, tanned covers and the best piece badly torn, so modest value overall.
